title: Quantile mesh instrumentation and sliceable explorer for route/model/region
creator: Evan Brooks
description: Enable robust p95/p99 telemetry and interactive exploration across three dimensions (route, model, region) by instrumenting a dense quantile mesh and building a sliceable explorer UI in the Console. This ticket wires the backend capture (tokens/sec, request size, KV-cache hit rate) into an enrichment pipeline that emits per-request quantile labels, stores rollups at multiple window resolutions, and surfaces sliceable visualizations and regression alerts. Goal: make it straightforward for SREs, runtime, and product owners to detect percentile regressions tied to model variants, endpoints, or geography and to drill down to representative request playbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Backend pipeline produces p50/p95/p99 rollups for every (route, model, region) combination at 1m and 5m resolutions
Console explorer allows filtering by route/model/region/time range and shows p50/p95/p99 + tokens/sec trendlines
Regression detector emits alerts when p95 or p99 shifts by >25% relative to a rolling 7-day baseline for a slice with >=1000 tokens/sec
Dashboard provides sample request playback links (playback harness) for any selected percentile bucket
End-to-end tests (regression harness) exercising synthetic replay are added and pass in CI
implementation_notes: Instrumentation: add quantile labels at the request emitter (edge proxy) and attach tokens_emitted, seq_len, kv_cache_hit boolean to telemetry events
Storage: use existing rollup tables (ClickHouse) with new partition keys (route, model, region) and time buckets 1m/5m/1h
Aggregation: compute weighted quantiles using t-digest per bucket to minimize memory overhead
Explorer UI: build sliceable front-end component in Console that queries rollups + raw sample TTL for playbacks; prefer incremental queries to avoid scanning high-cardinality tables
Alerting: integrate with existing regression watcher service; add configurable thresholds and mute windows per customer or release
Backwards compatibility: fall back to legacy route-level aggregator when model tag missing; record a warning metric for incomplete labels
Estimate assumes cross-team coordination with Runtime (instrumentation) and Data Infra (rollups)
